```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(readr)
```


```{r}
nodes <- read_delim(
  "new_taxdump/nodes.dmp",
  delim = "|",
  col_names = FALSE,
  trim_ws = TRUE,
  col_types = cols(.default = "c")
) %>%
  select(tax_id = X1, parent_tax_id = X2)

nodes <- nodes %>%
  mutate(
    tax_id = trimws(tax_id),
    parent_tax_id = trimws(parent_tax_id)
  )

root <- "10239"

virus_taxids <- root
repeat {
  children <- nodes %>%
    filter(parent_tax_id %in% virus_taxids) %>%
    pull(tax_id)
  
  new_ids <- setdiff(children, virus_taxids)
  
  if (length(new_ids) == 0) break
  
  virus_taxids <- c(virus_taxids, new_ids)
}

virus_taxids <- sort(unique(virus_taxids))

write_lines(virus_taxids, "virus_taxids.txt")

length(virus_taxids)
```

```{r}
start <- "10298"

lineage <- start

repeat {
  parent <- nodes %>%
    filter(tax_id == lineage[length(lineage)]) %>%
    pull(parent_tax_id)

  if (length(parent) == 0) {
    stop("TaxID not found in nodes: ", start)
  }

  if (parent == lineage[length(lineage)]) break

  lineage <- c(lineage, parent)
}


lineage_hhv <- lineage_hhv[-1]
lineage_corona <- lineage_corona[-1]
```
